content.title: About
content.content: Barbecue meat, NFS (1167) is a ready‑to‑eat product consisting of selected beef cuts marinated in the proprietary NFS sauce and pre‑grilled. The meat has a rich smoky aroma, a slightly sweet flavor, and a tender texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The NFS (Natural Flavor System) technology uses only natural spices and flavorings without artificial additives.
The meat is marinated for at least 12 hours, allowing deep flavor penetration.
The product undergoes double thermal processing: first marination, then slow smoking at low temperature.
Each portion contains about 150 g of ready‑to‑cook product, convenient for quick meals.
Barbecue meat NFS is popular in fast‑food outlets, cooking shows, and home kitchens.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Beef provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron from beef is highly bioavailable and helps maintain normal hemoglobin levels.

items.title: Source of zinc
items.content: Zinc supports immune function and participates in DNA synthesis.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The product supplies vitamins B12, B6, and niacin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Low in carbohydrates
items.content: Barbecue meat fits well into low‑carb diets as it contains virtually no carbs.

items.title: Beef allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to beef.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: The marinade contains salt; people monitoring sodium intake should limit portions.

items.title: Thermal handling
items.content: Improper reheating can allow bacterial growth; follow storage and heating instructions.

items.title: Saturated fat
items.content: The product contains saturated fats; those with high cholesterol should consume in moderation.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Barbecue meat can be reheated in the microwave (1–2 minutes) or on a skillet (2–3 minutes per side). It works well in sandwiches, salads, tacos, pasta dishes, or served as a main course with a side.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the product refrigerated at 0‑4 °C in its original packaging and consume within 5 days after opening. For longer storage, freeze in an airtight bag at –18 °C for up to 3 months. Ensure the meat is fully heated before eating.
